comment: Pages that render but are not reachable from any sidebar entry in sidebars.js, and that we have decided to leave that way for now. bin/check-orphan-pages.js reports anything not listed here. An empty note means the entry has not been reviewed yet; either wire the page into sidebars.js, mark it `unlisted: true` if it should stay out of navigation on purpose, or fill in the note explaining why it stays excepted. Regenerate with: node bin/check-orphan-pages.js --update-baseline
